title: Thinking on Obedience (and Discipline)
summary: Kahran and Divya set out to talk about discipline and end up unpacking obedience — its role in Indian schooling, in religion, and surprisingly in Amazon's 'disagree and commit' principle. Two self-described free-thinkers find themselves arguing that obedience can be tribal glue and a working tool inside high-trust collaborations.

intents.display: to question whether obedience and discipline have a place in your life
